# McDonald's


> McDonald's Corporation is one of the world's largest and most recognized quick-service restaurant brands, serving millions of customers daily across more than 100 countries and territories.


## About this llms.txt file


mcdonalds.com is a global, multilingual website with no single global homepage. Visitors are directed to their local market website based on region. This llms.txt file serves as the global  index, linking to market-specific llms.txt files for localized content.


For corporate-level information about McDonald's Corporation, please refer to the Corporate Information section below.


## Market-specific llms.txt files


- [McDonald's Taiwan (台灣)](https://mcdonalds.com/tw/llms.txt): 
  Taiwan market. Content in Traditional Chinese.




## Corporate information (corporate.mcdonalds.com)


- [McDonald's Corporation](https://corporate.mcdonalds.com/corpmcd/home.html): 
  Global corporate website for McDonald's Corporation.
- [About McDonald's](https://corporate.mcdonalds.com/corpmcd/our-company/who-we-are.html): 
  Company history, mission, values, and business model.
- [Global locations and markets](https://corporate.mcdonalds.com/corpmcd/our-company/where-we-operate.html):
Overview of countries and regions where McDonald's operates, with links to local market websites.
- [Investor Relations](https://corporate.mcdonalds.com/corpmcd/investors.html): 
  Financial reports, stock information, and earnings.
- [Contact McDonald's](https://corporate.mcdonalds.com/corpmcd/contact.html): 
  Corporate contact information and international directory.
